setup_cmd: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake libssl-dev
build_cmd: cd examples/linux/golioth_basics && printf '#define GOLIOTH_PSK_ID "device@project"\n#define GOLIOTH_PSK "secret"\n' > credentials.inc && rm -rf build && cmake -B build -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-Wl,-Map=$PWD/build/golioth_basics.map" && cmake --build build -j$(nproc)

setup_cmd:
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git cmake ninja-build gperf ccache dfu-util device-tree-compiler wget python3-dev xz-utils file make gcc && pip install west && wget -q -P /tmp https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/sdk-ng/releases/download/v0.17.4/zephyr-sdk-0.17.4_linux-x86_64_minimal.tar.xz && tar xf /tmp/zephyr-sdk-0.17.4_linux-x86_64_minimal.tar.xz -C $HOME && $HOME/zephyr-sdk-0.17.4/setup.sh -t arm-zephyr-eabi -h -c && echo "ZEPHYR_SDK_INSTALL_DIR=$HOME/zephyr-sdk-0.17.4" >> $GITHUB_ENV && mkdir -p ../.west && printf '[manifest]
path = %s
file = .ci-west-zephyr.yml
' "$(basename $PWD)" > ../.west/config && west config manifest.project-filter -- -hal_espressif,-hal_nordic,-hal_nxp,-mcuboot,-net-tools,-segger && west update -o=--depth=1 -n && pip install -r ../zephyr/scripts/requirements-base.txt
build_cmd: west build -p always -b nucleo_h563zi/stm32h563xx examples/zephyr/hello -d build/hello
docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/project" -w /project espressif/idf:v5.4.1 bash -c "idf.py -C examples/esp_idf/hello set-target esp32s3 build"
